'The next attack action card you play this turn gains +1{p}. Go again.'

GoAgain appears in printed_keywords, so it comes from the card DB keywords field - deliberately NOT authored here; authoring it again is a defect.

Shape: PLAY ability whose only effect is MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK with a filter. Handler (effect_types.py:4592-4618) READS mod/amount/filter/scope - verified; it queues {mod, amount, filter, scope} on the CONTROLLER's dsl_queued_attack_mods (not the turn player's).

Filter ATTACK_TYPE_IN ['Action']: the condition unions the attack card's types AND subtypes (condition_types.py:273-294) - an attack action card is types=['Action'], subtypes=['Attack'], so ['Action'] names exactly attack action cards; weapon attacks carry type Weapon and do not match. This is the 'attack action card' restriction the printed text makes.

Consumption verified at engine.py:1175-1236: while state.combat holds each newly declared attack, queued filter specs are compiled and evaluated against that attack card; the first match appends a stage-7.5 power effect (+1, routed through apply_power_gain_replacements so 'instead' replacements still see it) and the entry is CONSUMED - one-shot, so a second attack this turn gains nothing. Unused entries expire at end of turn (engine.py:797, 921-922), matching 'this turn'. Scope left at default TURN.

No gaps; every clause expressible.
